escenas.texto: We toured Oceania, Asia, Africa, Europe and the Americas. Now, the ranking that brings it all together: this week's global Top 10. This week in the World, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over six hundred and fifteen million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, the World edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The world rules: the top three of every list from every continent compete here, the same videos and the same numbers from this Sunday's world tour. One video per creator on each list. Every number comes from the official YouTube API. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. Next up, number ten, from Spain, YoSoyDander, with a video posted six days ago. Over fifteen million views. A Short of just nineteen seconds. It also has eighty-nine comments.

In position number nine, from Cyprus, crafter duck - DIY, with a video posted four days ago. Over twenty million views. A Short of just forty-nine seconds. It also has two hundred and sixty-five comments.

At number eight, from United Kingdom, DAZN Football, with “2026 Ballon d'Or Red Carpet Pre Show”. Over twenty-one million views. A video over seventy-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just one day.

Next up, number seven, from United States, Sofia Pevidor, with a video posted six days ago. Over twenty-one million views. A Short of just fifty-seven seconds. It also has six hundred and forty-one comments.

At number six, from United States, Conexwest, with a video posted four days ago. Over twenty-four million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and ten thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over seven thousand comments.

Next up, number five, from United States, IShowSpeed, with “Ishowspeed vs dude perfect gauntlet!”. Over thirty million views. A Short of just forty-nine seconds. It also has over four thousand comments.

In position number four, Sophie cindy, with “My daily duty as a mom of 5”. Over thirty million views. And get this: it's a channel with about eighty-eight thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over six thousand comments.

Bronze medal, ARTIST JOYBOY, with “Drawing LISA using 69 from Tarantino LLOUD”. Over thirty-three million views. And get this: it's a channel with about sixty-seven thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty-one seconds.

Silver medal, from India, Samay Raina, with a video posted two days ago. Over forty-four million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about six hundred and eighty thousand views per hour. It has the best engagement rate on this list: three out of every hundred viewers liked or commented.

And here it is. Number one most viewed, from India, Shivapriya Official , with “Mango leaf decoration ideas for diwali”. Over forty-seven million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and thirty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty seconds.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Number ten, from United States, Jenny Devil, with a video posted three days ago. Over eight thousand comments. A video over twenty-three minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over one point five million views.

Number nine, from Egypt, Mahmoud Zayed - محمود زايد, with a video posted six days ago. Over eleven thousand comments. A Short of just twenty-three seconds. It also has over three point two million views.

At number eight, from Türkiye, Vural Üzül, with a video posted four days ago. Over fourteen thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: fifteen out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over forty-nine minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.
Next up, number seven, from Mexico, Fede Vigevani Vlogs, with a video posted four days ago. Over sixteen thousand comments. It also has over eight point five million views.

Number six, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, with a video posted four days ago. Over twenty-five thousand comments. A video over twenty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over fifteen million views.

In position number five, from India, Free Fire India Official, with “Free fire india is here!”. Over twenty-seven thousand comments. It got there in just one day. It also has over five point three million views.

In position number four, from India, What Factzz, with a video posted six days ago. Over forty-five thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and twenty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty-seven seconds.

Bronze medal, from India, Samay Raina, with a video posted two days ago. Over forty-five thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about six hundred and eighty thousand views per hour. A video over fifty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Silver medal, from United Kingdom, The Diary Of A CEO, with a video posted five days ago. Over forty-five thousand comments. A video over one hundred and nine minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over five point one million views.

Drum roll, please. Number one most commented, from Mexico, Fede Vigevani, with a video posted six days ago. Over fifty-five thousand comments. A video over thirty-three minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over eighteen million views.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. Next up, number ten, Unspoken Stories, with “Nobody Believed Him At First His Whole Life Vanished When He Woke Up”. Over three hundred and forty-nine thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. And get this: it's a channel with about ninety-eight thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.

At number nine, SalesBendagra, with “Part 4, Subscribe For More.”. Over four hundred and seven thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about ninety-four thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over ten million views.

Coming in at number eight, Sophie cindy, with “My daily duty as a mom of 5”. Over four hundred and forty-one thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about eighty-eight thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over thirty million views.

Coming in at number seven, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, with a video posted four days ago. Over four hundred and ninety-seven thousand likes. A video over twenty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over fifteen million views.

Number six, from Pakistan, Heemi , with “She made a huge comeback this year!”. Over five hundred and twenty-nine thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and twenty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just sixteen seconds.

Bronze medal, from India, Kitchen CureAI , with a video posted six days ago. Over six hundred and eighty-four thousand likes. It also has over sixteen million views.
